owner.name: Tufts University Center for Cellular Agriculture

metadata.description: CAAIL marketplace — a curated map of the AI and machine-learning work in cellular agriculture: 345 papers by method and research area, plus the software, databases and per-species datasets the field uses.

plugins.name: caail
plugins.description: Query CAAIL when choosing tools, datasets or databases for a cell-ag experiment or pipeline, or when asking what AI work exists in cultivated meat and alternative protein. Static JSON, nothing to install or authenticate.

plugins.name: caail-contribute
plugins.description: Offers to suggest a paper, tool, dataset or database back to CAAIL when it turns out the library does not index it. Composes a prefilled GitHub issue for you to review and submit; it never files anything itself. Separate from the caail plugin so installing it is the consent, and removing it leaves querying intact.
